# pitch degree

An optional tuning-system degree index associated with this pitch value (e.g., degree 0 = origin, degree 7 = fifth in 12-EDO).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pitchDegree>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:pitchDegree`  

**Type:** `owl:DatatypeProperty`, `owl:FunctionalProperty`
